protocol:
PCR Using Q5® Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (M0493). 
Set up the following reaction:
Component25 µl Reaction50 µl ReactionFinal Concentration5X Q5 Reaction Buffer5 µl10 µl1X10 mM dNTPs0.5 µl1 µl200 µM10 µM Forward Primer1.25 µl2.5 µl0.5 µM10 µM Reverse Primer1.25 µl2.5 µl0.5 µMTemplate DNAvariablevariable< 1,000 ngQ5 Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase0.25 µl0.5 µl0.02 U/µl5X Q5 High GC Enhancer (optional)(5 µl)(10 µl)(1X)Nuclease-Free Waterto 25 µlto 50 µl.  
Gently mix the reaction.
Collect all liquid to the bottom of the tube by a quick spin if necessary and overlay the sample with mineral oil if using a PCR machine without a heated lid.
Transfer PCR tubes to a PCR machine and begin thermocycling.

script:
# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='5X Q5 Reaction Buffer', volume='5 µl or 10 µl', final_concentration='1X')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='10 mM dNTPs', volume='0.5 µl or 1 µl', final_concentration='200 µM')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='10 µM Forward Primer', volume='1.25 µl or 2.5 µl', final_concentration='0.5 µM')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='10 µM Reverse Primer', volume='1.25 µl or 2.5 µl', final_concentration='0.5 µM')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='Template DNA', volume='variable', max_amount='< 1,000 ng')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase', volume='0.25 µl or 0.5 µl', final_concentration='0.02 U/µl')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='5X Q5 High GC Enhancer', volume='5 µl or 10 µl (optional)', final_concentration='1X')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='Nuclease-Free Water', volume='to 25 µl or to 50 µl (to final volume)')
mix(container='PCR tube', speed='gentle')
centrifuge(container='PCR tube', duration='quick spin', purpose='collect liquid to bottom')
pipette(container='PCR tube', reagent='mineral oil', volume='overlay (volume not specified)', condition='if using PCR machine without heated lid')
transfer(container='PCR tube', destination='PCR machine')
incubate(container='PCR tube', temperature='thermocycling (PCR program, not specified)', duration='PCR program (not specified)')
